payload.title: Release engineering & distribution: standalone CLI, package publish, image recipes, CI matrix
payload.description:
Make Frick publicly consumable (it is pre-1.0 and monorepo-private today).

- CLI is private to the monorepo (pnpm cli <command>) and imports server internals directly; publish a standalone npm CLI (status.md:61-62; operations.md:837-840).
- Default deploy image builds the canonical monorepo server; add published-package and scaffolded-app image recipes (status.md:62-64).
- Release policy + multi-target distribution (npm / SwiftPM / Maven), version dimensions (framework/schema/protocol/artifact), support policy, provenance/signing (hardening spec:1053-1112).
- Canonical CI build matrix + generated-artifact drift checks across TS/Swift/Kotlin (hardening spec:1118-1154).

Target: clean public packages, reproducible app images, documented release policy, drift-proof CI.
